initial_directives: Implement the PriceOracle staleness check, Chainlink round validation, and fallback oracle requested by the bounty issue. Work only through a public fork and submit a reviewable pull request.
directives_applied: Validate positive price and completed rounds (answeredInRound >= roundId).
Reject invalid timestamps and use an owner-configurable MAX_STALENESS window.
Use a configured fallback feed when the primary feed is stale; revert when both are stale.
Emit StalePrice with the primary feed update timestamp.
